description: This file defines a Python class 'LakeraAIGuardrail' that extends 'CustomGuardrail' to implement guardrail logic using Lakera AI v2 API. It includes methods for making API calls, masking PII in messages, and handling guardrail violations, with detailed logging and exception handling.

classes.name: LakeraAIGuardrail
classes.description: A guardrail implementation that interacts with Lakera AI v2 API to evaluate messages for violations, mask PII, and handle flagged content with configurable actions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LakeraAIGuardrail with API credentials, configuration options, and sets up the HTTP client.

methods.name: call_v2_guard
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous API call to Lakera AI v2 guard endpoint with provided messages and request data, returning the response and masked entity count.

methods.name: _mask_pii_in_messages
methods.description: Masks detected PII in messages based on Lakera AI response, replacing sensitive content with masked tokens.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-processing hook that calls the guard API, handles violations, masks PII if needed, and adds guardrail info to headers before proceeding.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Moderation hook similar to pre-call, invoked during call to evaluate and handle flagged content.

methods.name: _is_only_pii_violation
methods.description: Checks if the Lakera AI response contains only PII violations.

methods.name: _get_http_exception_for_blocked_guardrail
methods.description: Generates an HTTP 400 exception indicating guardrail policy violation.
